settings.content: Brand-level settings for the PHAM dark luxury architecture. These keys are consumed by every pham-* section, snippet, and asset.

settings.label: Accent color override
settings.info: Optional. Overrides PHAM's champagne gold (#C5A880). Leave blank to use the default.

settings.label: The single product to feature
settings.info: Used by the header PRODUCT link, hero CTA fallback, cart and search empty states. PHAM is a single-product storefront.

settings.label: Enable direct purchase when pre-order is closed
settings.info: When pre-order/waitlist is closed and inventory is available, PDP and collection cards show Add to Cart instead of PRE-ORDER CLOSED.

settings.label: Sold out message
settings.default: This run is closed. Join the atelier list for the next release.

settings.content: Before go-live: (1) Settings → Payments + Shipping + Markets. (2) Create pages (see scripts/pham-launch-setup.graphql — Admin UI or GraphiQL). (3) Fill policies in Settings → Policies. (4) Select Featured product above. (5) Deploy scripts/pham-waitlist-backend.gs + ORDERS_PAID webhook (Admin → Notifications → Webhooks). (6) Cloudflare Turnstile: allowlist storefront domain.

settings.label: Enable waitlist signups
settings.info: When off, pre-order buttons and the signup form show CLOSED.

settings.label: Use waitlist open/close dates
settings.info: When off, waitlist stays open until you disable signups above. When on, only accepts signups between the dates below.

settings.label: Waitlist page handle
settings.info: Shopify page handle for the signup form, e.g. pre-order → /pages/pre-order

settings.label: Waitlist thank-you page handle
settings.info: After signup, customers are redirected here. Create a page with this handle and assign the “waitlist-thank-you” template.

settings.label: Waitlist app proxy path
settings.info: POST endpoint for the PHAM Pre-order Waitlist app. Install the app and deploy its theme extension.

settings.label: Enable honeypot field
settings.info: Hidden field that blocks basic bots.

settings.content: Contact uses Shopify’s built-in form and spam protection (hCaptcha when needed). Messages arrive in Shopify Admin → Inbox / customer email notifications. No Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Turnstile required.

settings.label: Default meta description
settings.default: PHAM Atelier is an independent fashion label from Vietnam creating edition-based dark outerwear and design objects through restraint, proportion, construction and controlled detail.

settings.label: Homepage meta description
settings.default: PHAM Atelier is an independent fashion label from Vietnam. Explore PHAM-001, Edition 01, dark outerwear, garment construction and the design process behind the first release.

settings.label: Product fallback meta description
settings.default: PHAM-001 — Edition 01 by PHAM Atelier is a limited cropped bomber developed in Vietnam around proportion, construction and controlled detail.

settings.label: Waitlist pages meta description
settings.default: Join the PHAM pre-order waitlist. Register interest while the next edition is in development.

settings.label: About meta description
settings.default: About PHAM Atelier — the independent fashion label founded in Vietnam in 2026 behind PHAM-001, Edition 01 and future edition-based objects.

settings.label: FAQ meta description
settings.default: Pre-order, sizing, shipping, and returns — frequently asked questions from the PHAM atelier.

settings.label: Size guide meta description
settings.default: PHAM size guide — body measurements in centimetres for a precise, relaxed fit.

settings.label: Contact meta description
settings.default: Contact PHAM Atelier at phamofficial.com for PHAM-001, sizing, order support and official brand enquiries.

settings.label: Sign in meta description
settings.default: Sign in to your PHAM account — orders, addresses, and edition updates.

settings.label: Register meta description
settings.default: Create your PHAM account — one registry for orders and future atelier editions.

settings.label: Collection fallback meta description
settings.default: Browse PHAM Atelier — PHAM-001 and future limited-edition darkwear, outerwear and design objects from the independent Vietnam-based label.

settings.label: Google Analytics 4 measurement ID
settings.info: Example: G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave blank to disable.

settings.label: Meta Pixel ID
settings.info: Numeric pixel ID only. Leave blank to disable.

settings.label: Google Search Console verification
settings.info: Content value from the HTML meta tag verification method.

settings.content: Waitlist signups arrive via Shopify checkout/contact email — handle pre-order links and access manually. Optional: Klaviyo for waitlist segments.

settings.label: Klaviyo public API key (optional)
settings.info: When set, loads Klaviyo onsite tracking for waitlist segments.

settings.label: Marquee text
settings.default: WORLDWIDE SHIPPING · ATELIER PHAM · SIMPLY BEING · FULLY LIVING · EDITION 01

settings.label: Marquee speed
settings.info: Animation duration of one full loop. Lower values = faster scroll.

settings.label: Instagram URL
settings.info: Full URL, e.g. https://instagram.com/pham

settings.label: TikTok URL
settings.info: Full URL, e.g. https://tiktok.com/@pham

settings.label: Facebook URL
settings.info: Official PHAM Facebook page

settings.label: Returns message
settings.default: Returns accepted within 14 days of delivery

settings.label: Duties message
settings.default: Import duties may apply based on destination

settings.label: Contact email
settings.info: Shown in the footer and on the contact page.

settings.content: Reusable controls for the active numbered edition. Keep PRELAUNCH until commerce, email delivery, fulfillment and legal review are complete.
